title.yo: Python + WordPress API: kó ìròyìn jọ

text.en: Python and the WordPress API downloaded public reports from Isa’s office website and saved links to each source.
text.ha: Python da WordPress API sun sauke rahotannin jama’a daga shafin ofishin Isa kuma sun adana hanyoyin zuwa kowace majiya.
text.yo: Python àti WordPress API ṣe ìgbàsílẹ̀ àwọn ìròyìn gbangba láti ojúlé ọ́fíìsì Isa, wọ́n sì fipamọ́ ìjápọ̀ sí orísun kọ̀ọ̀kan.
text.ig: Python na WordPress API budatara akụkọ ọha site na webụsaịtị ụlọ ọrụ Isa ma chekwaa njikọ isi mmalite ọ bụla.

text.en: Beautiful Soup removed webpage code so we could read and analyse the report text.
text.ha: Beautiful Soup ya cire lambar gina shafin yanar gizo domin mu iya karantawa da nazarin rubutun rahoton.
text.yo: Beautiful Soup yọ kóòdù ojú ìwé kúrò kí a lè ka ọ̀rọ̀ ìròyìn, kí a sì ṣe ìtúpalẹ̀ rẹ̀.
text.ig: Beautiful Soup wepụrụ koodu ibe weebụ ka anyị nwee ike ịgụ ma nyochaa ederede akụkọ.

title.en: Source checks: avoid repeats and wrong totals
title.ha: Duba majiyoyi: guje wa maimaituwa da jimillar da ba daidai ba
title.yo: Àyẹ̀wò orísun: yẹra fún àtúnkà àti àpapọ̀ tí kò tọ́
title.ig: Nlele isi mmalite: zere mmegharị na ngụkọta na-ezighị ezi

text.en: We removed exact copies and checked figures against their source reports, keeping plans separate from reported delivery and avoiding overlapping beneficiary totals.
text.ha: Mun cire kwafe iri ɗaya kuma mun duba lambobi da rahotannin tushensu, tare da ware tsare-tsare daga abin da aka ruwaito an bayar da guje wa jimillar da ke ƙirga masu amfana fiye da sau ɗaya.
text.yo: A yọ ẹ̀dà kan náà kúrò, a sì ṣàyẹ̀wò nọ́ńbà pẹ̀lú ìròyìn orísun wọn, a yà ètò sọ́tọ̀ sí ìpèsè tí a ròyìn, a sì yẹra fún àpapọ̀ tó ń ka olùgbà ìrànwọ́ kan ju ẹ̀ẹ̀kan lọ.
text.ig: Anyị wepụrụ akwụkwọ ndị bụ otu ma lelee ọnụọgụ na akụkọ isi mmalite ha, na-ekewapụ atụmatụ na nnyefe a kọrọ ma na-ezere ngụkọta na-agụ otu ndị natara enyemaka ọzọ.

text.en: scikit-learn uses TF-IDF to highlight distinctive words and NMF to find 8 recurring themes in the selected English reports.
text.ha: scikit-learn yana amfani da TF-IDF don nuna kalmomin da ke bambanta rubuce-rubuce da NMF don gano jigogi 8 masu maimaituwa a zaɓaɓɓun rahotannin Turanci.
text.yo: scikit-learn ń lo TF-IDF láti fi àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tó ń yà àkọsílẹ̀ sọ́tọ̀ hàn àti NMF láti rí àkòrí 8 tí ń tún wá nínú àwọn ìròyìn Gẹ̀ẹ́sì tí a yàn.
text.ig: scikit-learn na-eji TF-IDF gosipụta okwu na-ekewapụ akwụkwọ na NMF chọpụta isiokwu 8 na-emegharị n'akụkọ Bekee ahọpụtara.

title.ha: Rukunonin da aka zaɓa da hannu: sanya wa ayyuka suna
title.yo: Ẹ̀ka tí a fi ọwọ́ yàn: fi àmì sí iṣẹ́
title.ig: Ngalaba e ji aka họpụta: nye ọrụ aha

text.en: We assigned activity categories by reading the reports; one activity can belong to several categories.
text.ha: Mun sanya ayyuka cikin rukunoni ta hanyar karanta rahotannin; aiki ɗaya na iya shiga rukunoni da yawa.
text.yo: A pín iṣẹ́ sí ẹ̀ka nípasẹ̀ kíka ìròyìn; iṣẹ́ kan lè wà nínú ẹ̀ka púpọ̀.
text.ig: Anyị kenyere ngalaba ọrụ site n'ịgụ akụkọ; otu ọrụ nwere ike ịdị n'ọtụtụ ngalaba.

title.en: Phrase counts: build the word cloud

text.en: A script counts each phrase once per report for the concept cloud; the category view counts activities. Larger labels mean more records.
text.ha: Shirin yana ƙirga kowace jimla sau ɗaya a kowane rahoto don girgijen ra’ayoyi; kallon rukunoni yana ƙirga ayyuka. Manyan sunaye suna nuna ƙarin bayanai.
text.yo: Ètò kan ń ka gbólóhùn kọ̀ọ̀kan lẹ́ẹ̀kan nínú ìròyìn kọ̀ọ̀kan fún ìkójọ èrò; ìwò ẹ̀ka ń ka iṣẹ́. Àwọn àmì ńlá túmọ̀ sí àkọsílẹ̀ púpọ̀ sí i.
text.ig: Ederede mmemme na-agụ ahịrịokwu ọ bụla otu ugboro n'akụkọ ọ bụla maka igwe echiche; nlele ngalaba na-agụ ọrụ. Aha ndị buru ibu pụtara ndekọ ndị ọzọ.

title.en: Sources and guided chat: explain the findings
title.ha: Majiyoyi da tattaunawa mai jagora: bayyana sakamako
title.yo: Orísun àti ìjíròrò pẹ̀lú ìtọ́sọ́nà: ṣàlàyé ohun tí a rí
title.ig: Isi mmalite na mkparịta ụka nwere nduzi: kọwaa nchọpụta

text.en: The dashboard links figures and connections to reports; the chatbot follows prepared questions. The reports do not independently prove impact or cover his whole career.
text.ha: Allon taƙaitaccen bayani yana haɗa lambobi da alaƙoƙi zuwa rahotanni; chatbot yana bin tambayoyin da aka shirya. Rahotannin ba su tabbatar da tasiri ta hanya mai zaman kanta ba, kuma ba su ƙunshi duk tarihin aikinsa ba.
text.yo: Àtẹ àlàyé so nọ́ńbà àti ìbáṣepọ̀ mọ́ ìròyìn; olùrànlọ́wọ́ ìjíròrò tẹ̀lé ìbéèrè tí a ti pèsè. Ìròyìn kò fi ipa múlẹ̀ ní ọ̀nà olómìnira, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni kò bo gbogbo ìtàn iṣẹ́ rẹ̀.
text.ig: Ibe nchịkọta na-ejikọta ọnụọgụ na njikọ na akụkọ; onye nduzi mkparịta ụka na-eso ajụjụ a kwadebere. Akụkọ anaghị egosi mmetụta n'onwe ha ma ọ bụ kpuchie ọrụ ndụ ya niile.
